determinism_note: This file intentionally contains no timestamp; SHA-256 is a function only of the registered inputs.

framework_implications.dependence_on_dark_energy: The numbers are fixed at DESI DR2's dark energy. With a true cosmological constant the same idea gives a constant a0, which a precise enough determination would score as a FAIL of this entry.
framework_implications.k0_status: A T4 forward prediction; the scope and threshold of kill condition K0 are unchanged.
framework_implications.on_failure: a0 is not set by the dark-energy density in this form, and the evolving MOND-like scale of THEORY.md §6.2 loses its registered form. The GSC core (T1-T3) is unaffected.

physics_status: Exact consequence of a0 proportional to the square root of the dark-energy density, with DESI DR2's published dark-energy histories. Not a fit: the shape has no free parameter, and only ratios to today's a0 are predicted.

below_z_1_5.note: Predicted change of a0 over the redshift range in which Ciocan et al. (2026) see a0 rise by a factor of about 2; not in the scored range.

comparison_at_z3.lcdm_simulations: rising (Mayer et al., arXiv:2206.04333: about 3 times by z = 2)

registered_parameters.relation: a0(z)/a0(0) = sqrt(rho_DE(z)/rho_DE(0)); rho_DE from the CPL form
registered_parameters.source: DESI DR2 Results II, arXiv:2503.14738 v3, eqs. 25-28

scoring_rule.pass: z < 3 for every scored determination, and at least one has sigma <= (1 - upper band edge)/2, so that it can tell the prediction from a constant a0.
scoring_rule.scope: Determinations published after this registration. RC100 (Nestor Shachar et al., ApJ 944, 78, 2023) suggested the prediction and is not scored.
scoring_rule.statistic: For each published determination of the relation's acceleration scale from rotation curves of at least 10 galaxies with median redshift z >= 2: r_obs = a0(z)/a0_ref +/- sigma (1 sigma; for asymmetric errors the side facing the band). a0_ref is the same method's value at z <= 0.1, or its value in a lower-redshift bin of the same survey (the prediction is then the ratio of the formula at the two median redshifts), or else the canonical 1.20 +/- 0.24, whose uncertainty is added to sigma. d is the distance from r_obs to the registered band at that redshift (0 inside it), and z = d/sigma.
scoring_rule.sub_threshold: z < 3 everywhere, but no determination yet precise enough to tell the prediction from a constant a0.

title: Milgrom's acceleration scale follows the dark-energy density: a0 at z = 3 is 0.74 (0.63-0.78) of today's
